name: Formidable Alice
source:
Marisa's a smooth talker, but can she smooth-talk her way into Alice's heart?

Chat with Alice and find out!

[from [url=https://kurantob.itch.io/formidable-alice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
魔理沙能說會道，可她能憑這張巧嘴，走進愛麗絲心裡嗎？

和愛麗絲聊聊，尋找答案吧！

[摘自[url=https://kurantob.itch.io/formidable-alice]itch.io[/url]]
